instruction: Go directly from your starting position to the sink nearest to the bucket. Then go directly from that sink to the lamp that is on the lower floor and has an electrical controller nearby. After reaching the sink and until you reach the lamp, avoid the door between the hallway on the lower floor and the living room, and pass through at least two portals.
